No clothing, hair, accessories or new features; this base must be overlaid with existing game clothes and hair. Keep all empty and transparent areas transparent, all original margins, cell dimensions, alignment and duplicated frames. Do not move, resize, merge, add or remove any frame. Retain the small pixel-art style and original palette. The same shading should remain consistent through the entire walking loop.
